title: A $6 SD Nu Gundam kit rebuilt with hand-painted detail
description: A straight-built $6 SD Nu Gundam kit was taken apart and every part was detail painted. Black, yellow, red and green details were hand-painted, the panel lines were filled in, and a flat clear coat gave the whole kit an even finish before it was put back together.
itemDetails: This is a Bandai SD (super deformed) RX-93 Nu Gundam plastic model kit. It is a small, low-cost kit that snaps together without glue and comes moulded mostly in white, so most of its colour details are left to stickers or paint.
repairDetails:
The kit started as a plain straight build, with most of its colour details missing.

It was taken apart piece by piece. The parts were cleaned up with a hobby knife, and the details were hand-painted with fine brushes: black on the joints and vents, yellow on the fin funnels and V-fin, red on the chest and the camera parts, green on the eyes, and pink on the beam saber.

Panel lines were filled in and the excess was wiped away with cotton buds. Every part was then sprayed with a flat clear coat to even out the finish.

Finally, the kit was put back together, with its fin funnels, rifle, shield and beam saber.
